comment: THE ONE PLACE that says which verification a changed file requires.
A lane is required when a file the push changes matches one of its `triggers`.
verify_plan.py reads this table for both halves: scripts/verify-once.sh runs the
stale lanes in ONE invocation, and the pre-push gate 2c4 refuses a push whose
required lane has no passing receipt for the exact bytes that trigger it.
A miss found on a hosted run belongs HERE: add the trigger that would have
required the lane, in the same commit that repairs the miss.

layers.why: the static gates read every source and script: citations, doc form, header, door pins
hosted-only: the barrier gate; a wave once verified neither C0s nor C1bw and went red
hosted-only: doc links to modules behind a feature
doc link budget per crate; a new link in a private or feature-gated doc costs one
the exported door set is pinned to the ABI revision, read from the built library
reassembly and fragmentation legs, each with a pinned test count
the demo's config expansion, sessions driver targets and their count guards
the legs behind non-default features, run and validated
the census: a test behind a feature must be claimed by a leg

commands.why: every count guard the push reaches, measured: a moved test set must move its number

hosted_only.why: Layer M needs zenohd and the pico CLI, which the build host lacks; it is printed as deferred and is not a local pass
